summary_1line: During the Ashvamedha campaign, Arjuna defeats young Meghasandhi of Magadha but spares him, then continues subduing kingdoms as the sacrificial horse roams.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands with the Gandiva bow as his arrows shatter Meghasandhi’s golden mace mid‑charge, fragments scattering across the battlefield.
The young prince Meghasandhi, disarmed and defeated, folds his hands before Arjuna while the wandering sacrificial horse waits nearby.
The richly adorned Ashvamedha horse wanders along the sea‑coast while Arjuna follows in armor with the Gandiva bow.
